## v1.7.0 — 2026-03-17

Version 1.7.0 introduces PostgreSQL support, Stripe billing integration, email functionality, and usage enforcement capabilities. This release also includes important legal document updates and security improvements from the previous v1.6.0 cycle, along with development toolchain optimizations.

### ✨ Features

- Added PostgreSQL database support, Stripe billing integration, email functionality, and usage enforcement features

### 🔧 Improvements

- Updated Terms of Service and Privacy Policy documentation

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Applied security audit fixes and vulnerability patches

### 🧹 Chores

- Optimized development dependencies by hoisting duplicates to root and normalizing TypeScript configuration paths

### Contributors

@mttaylor, @Matt
